capabilities: Auto-import your entire RetroAchievements game library as notes
Add individual game or subset notes on demand
Generate a Bases view of the game notes library
Save game metadata as internal links to connect games
Organize game notes into console subfolders
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a search tool; it imports RetroAchievements game metadata into notes.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README notes it is not endorsed by the RetroAchievements team.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull game metadata from RetroAchievements into notes for discovering connections between your games.

relations.evidence: Necessary to communicate with the RetroAchievements servers.

requires.name: RetroAchievements account with web API key

summary: RetroAchievements integration that imports your game library as notes with metadata, adds individual game notes, and generates a Bases view.
